caption: The drawing features two main objects centered in the lower half of the composition, both appearing to be representations of a shield shown from the front and the side. The shield depicted on the left has a rectangular shape with rounded corners and a slightly convex surface. Its surface is colored in shades of brown and orange with a polished, reflective appearance. Around the edge, there is a decorative Greek key pattern in a darker brown. In the center of the shield’s front, there is a large, ornate letter "P" rendered in a grey or silvery color with detailed highlights and shadows. To the right, there is a side view of the same shield, displaying its thickness and a handle attached to the back; the same Greek key pattern runs along the edge, and the handle is cylindrical with a flat round backing, both rendered in brown shades matching the shield. The background is plain and beige. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature that reads "FUMAGALLI" in uppercase letters.
title: Cuff Buttons
